g.text: automation — n8n (chi Post Analytics — dong bo metrics)
Khac biet so voi so do goc
Theo docs/architecture.md muc 2.4: token la stateless,
n8n CHI dung cho Post Analytics
Facebook (Phan he 8, D21). KHONG tham gia dang bai.
Admin = query DB dong bo; Order = cron + webhook;
- MetricsSyncWorkflow chay dinh ky (n8n cron), goi
moi truong**, khong luu DB. Chi `accessToken` (Page Token)
duoc ma hoa AES-256 luu DB.
